Minion_Expander.description: Increases minion range and increases speed by 5%. Stacks when two are used (range becomes 9x9).

Flycatcher.description: Increases the speed of a minion by 20%.

Diamond_Spreading.description: Occasionally collects a Diamond in addition to regular resources 1/10 chnace
Diamond_Spreading.notes: Wiki states 'occasionally' but does not give a numeric probability — fill in if you have a value.

Potato_Spreading.description: Occasionally collects a Potato in addition to regular resources; may be restricted to one minion per profile.
Potato_Spreading.notes: Wiki: 'may be used in only one minion per profile'.

Enchanted_Egg.description: For Chicken minions: guarantees an egg drop after chicken spawns.

Flint_Shovel.description: For Gravel minions: guarantees flint on harvest.

Lesser_Soulflow_Engine.description: Reduces normal minion output but causes the minion to generate Soulflow items instead. (Wiki notes: reduces output by 50%.)
Lesser_Soulflow_Engine.notes: Effect: -50% output, creates Soulflow items (see wiki).

Soulflow_Engine.description: Generates Soulflow items; wiki notes additional effects like increasing speed of certain minions per tier (see wiki).
Soulflow_Engine.notes: Complex effect; check wiki for per-minion details.

Corrupt_Soil.description: Causes mob-spawning minions to spawn Corrupted Mobs / drop Corrupt Fragments.

Sleepy_Hollow.description: Occasionally collects Purple Candy; may be limited to one minion per profile (wiki).

Auto_Smelter.description: Automatically smelts items gathered by the minion (e.g., ore -> ingot).

Compactor.description: Compacts resources into block form (e.g., iron => block of iron).

Super_Compactor.description: Compacts items into their enchanted forms (e.g., enchanted iron) when enough resources are available.

Dwarven_Super_Compactor.description: Combines Auto Smelter and Super Compactor functionality; smelts and compacts into enchanted forms.

Enchanted_Shears.description: For Sheep: automatically shears spawned sheep to produce wool (behavior depends on sheep minion).

Berberis_Fuel_Injector.description: Special item listed on the wiki (see page); behavior should be verified on wiki/game.
